name: LinkedIn Recruiter: Save recommended matches to the project (automated sourcing)
description: Adds a project's RECOMMENDED candidates (LinkedIn Automated Sourcing → Recommended matches, /discover/automatedSourcing/review) to the pipeline. The recruiter_save_recommendations strategy hovers each recommendation row and clicks its 'Save to first stage' button (data-test-save-to-first-stage), up to target_count (default 10), collecting name+profile_url; verifies the project's ACTIVE count rose. Returns `people` so the backend can push them as linkedin.lead. Params: project_url, target_count. GEOGRAPHY: `allowed_locations` (same ";"/"|" spec as the search facet) is enforced per row BEFORE anything is added — LinkedIn's Automated Sourcing ignores the position's location entirely (it recommended Meta/Amazon/Microsoft engineers for a `latam` job). Each row's lockup caption is read and matched against the country at the END of the location string; a row outside the geography — or with an unreadable location — is skipped and reported in skipped_examples. Blank/unresolved ⇒ no filter.

steps.intent: Add recommended matches to the project
